claims.hypothesis: Unidentified lines in SrcI are salts

claims.result: About 60 lines of NaCl, KCl and isotopologues detected up to v=6
claims.finding: First ISM detection of these molecules outside evolved-star ejecta

evidence.quote: This is the first detection of these molecules in the interstellar medium not associated with the ejecta of evolved stars.

claims.hypothesis: Vibrational excitation can be explained by a single temperature in LTE
claims.experiment: Rotation and vibration diagrams, RADEX models
claims.result: Low rotational but high vibrational temperatures
claims.finding: Not LTE; radiative excitation by 25-45 micron field most likely

evidence.quote: The emission from the vibrationally excited transitions is inconsistent with a single temperature, implying the lines are not in LTE.

evidence.quote: We conclude that there is no simple model that explains the observed pattern of low rotational and high vibrational temperature.
